scenes.narration: Volcanoes are openings in Earth's crust where molten rock called magma can rise.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view of a volcanic landscape with dark lava fields and steam rising, realistic style, high detail
scenes.motion_direction: slow pan right to left across the scene

scenes.narration: Deep beneath the surface, intense heat turns solid rock into molten magma.
scenes.prompt: Cross-section of Earth's mantle showing rising magma chamber with glowing orange core, scientific illustration style
scenes.motion_direction: zoom in on the magma chamber

scenes.narration: As gases expand within the magma, pressure builds until it can no longer be contained.
scenes.prompt: Volcanic vent with thick gray ash plume and steam erupting upward, dramatic lighting
scenes.motion_direction: pan up following the rising ash column

scenes.narration: When the overlying rock breaks, magma reaches the surface and erupts.
scenes.prompt: Explosive volcano eruption with lava flowing down a crater rim and smoke billowing into sky
scenes.motion_direction: zoom out to reveal full landscape after eruption
